title: नेपालको मौलिक संवत नेपाल संवतको देशैभर रौनक, काठमाडौँमा यसरी मनाइयो (तस्बिरहरु)
content:
Kathmandu. Nepal Sambat 1147 is being celebrated today by organizing various programs across the country. Mha Puja is also being performed today on the occasion of Nepal Sambat, which is celebrated by the Newar community as the new year. The Newar community in the Kathmandu Valley, as well as in the country and abroad, is celebrating Nepal Sambat by holding various cultural programs, rallies, and exchanging greetings. Nepal Sambat is being celebrated by taking out a rally with various cultural tableaus and musical instruments from Basantapur, Kathmandu. Various organizations of the Newar community and the general public are participating in the rally. The Newar community has been celebrating Nepal Sambat as its New Year. It is historically believed that national figure Shankhadhar Sakhwa started Nepal Sambat in 937 BS (880 AD) by freeing the loans of poor people. Nepal Sambat is the original calendar of Nepal. It has represented the history, culture, and identity of Nepal. On this occasion, the Newar community has a tradition of worshipping their bodies and souls by performing Mha Puja and praying for happiness, peace, prosperity, and good health.
